verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud's official MCP server lets a user's AI agent create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics "all from the conversation," with user-controlled permissions and the ability to disconnect at any time. That is natural-language operation of the product. Separately, built-in Natural Language Search via LLM integrations lets queries themselves be phrased in natural language. missing for 10: evidence that conversational operation covers self-hosted (non-Cloud) deployments, in-depth documentation of supported commands and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP workflow works as claimed.
